0022600095.text: The Pacers (1-0, 2nd in the Central, 7th in the East) host the Dallas Mavericks (0-1, 5th in the Southwest, 14th in the West) in their second game of the season, and Indiana is still 0-0 at home. Johnny Furphy is out with a knee injury after surgery, while Aaron Nesmith and T.J. McConnell are day-to-day with hamstring injuries and are game-time decisions. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II, who is out after foot surgery, and Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are day-to-day and game-time decisions with thumb, calf, knee and heel injuries, respectively. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Indiana lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
